name: menu-hemat
description: Perencana menu harian hemat tinggi protein (PWA + Android via Capacitor)

scripts.prepare-web: mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json sw.js icon.svg icon-192.png icon-512.png www/
scripts.android:add: npm run prepare-web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare-web && npx cap sync android
